title: Model steering onboarding journey: canary, A/B, and fallback policy screens
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design a compact, developer-focused onboarding flow and asset set to teach users how to steer model traffic: canary deployments, A/B splits, and fallback/pin policies. The goal is to reduce first-time setup time for release managers and provide reusable screenshot assets for docs, quickstarts, and in-console tooltips. This ticket covers hero screens, the progressive traffic slider micro-interaction, alternative variant UIs for 'A/B vs. Canary', fallback policy modal copy & visuals, and a compact empty-state for users without existing pinned versions.
acceptance_criteria: Three validated screen groups generated: Canary setup, A/B split setup, Fallback & pin-by-version modal
All screens available in desktop (1440px) and mobile (375px) artboards in Figma
Microcopy approved by PM describing traffic allocation, safety thresholds, and autoscaling hints
Prototype shows progressive slider animation and state transitions for 0% -> 10% -> 100% adoption
Exported PNGs and web-optimized assets uploaded to Drive for docs team
Accessibility contrast checks passed for labels, and controls have keyboard focus states documented
Design tokens (colors, spacing, font sizes) referenced in the component handoff doc
Dev handoff checklist filled with QA steps, PRD links, and sample API payloads for screenshots
deliverables: Figma file with separate pages: Onboarding Flow, Component Library, Exported Screenshots
Animated prototype (progressive slider; 3 states) share link
Screenshot pack (PNG/SVG) sized for docs hero (1200x600), console thumbnails (560x280), and social preview
Design handoff doc (MD) with component tokens, aria labels, and microcopy guidelines
